remaining_cautions.evidence_context: DBAASP-linked rows using Klebsiella pneumoniae ATCC 43816 and Enterococcus faecium NTCC 12697 conflict with primary source ATCC CRM 43861 and NCTC 12697. Values are retained but those rows remain source_conflict.

DBAASP percent-cytotoxicity classes at 100 μM are not exact numeric table values in local XML/PDF; Figure 8 is graphical and Table 6 gives IC50/N.I. endpoints. These rows remain source_conflict, not fabricated source_verified values.
The local supplementary ZIP contains a PDF with RP-HPLC purity and MALDI-TOF spectra figures for the five peptides; it does not add extractable activity/toxicity tables.
